photos.c: Belgrave's Winning AAA 12-Stage Team at Sutton Park. Back row: Andy Graffin, Spencer Barden, Paul Freary, Stephen Sharp, Alaster Stewart, David Anderson, Allen Graffin, Paul Evans. Front row: Lee Hurst, Mark Miles, Alan Mead (team manager), Richard Ward, Charles Herrington.

Above (1): Belgrave's men retained the AAA 6-Stage Road Relay Championship at Sutton Park in October 2002. Mark Miles, Richard Ward, Spencer Barden, Stephen Sharp, Allen Graffin and David Anderson celebrate keeping hold of the trophy for another year. This is the hardest team title to win - can they make it three in a row in October 2003?

Top centre: At the end of his stage Stephen Sharp had clocked the second fastest short stage of the day - second only to our own Andy Graffin - but was later pushed down to third fastest by another Belgravian, David Anderson.
Front page: Stephen Sharp and Martin Dent head the field in the opening "Sweatshop" Surrey CC League Race in Richmond Park.
Right: Stephen Sharp heads a blistering finish in the 1500m at Bedford in the Golden Jubilee Cup Final.
Second left: Yet another Belgravian in the top ten times of the day. Stephen Sharp was fourth best of the day around the short stage and brought the Bels up eight places to second.

Bottom right: The victorious Belgrave crew can't stop smiling after retaining their title. Standing: Jonathan Blackledge (stage 6), Al Stewart (11), Kevin Nash (3), Adam Zawadski (12), Martin Dent (7), Paul Freary (1), Paul Evans (9 - and what proved to be his last team run for Belgrave), David Anderson (4). Kneeling: Allen Graffin (5), Will Cockerell (10), Alan Mead (team manager), Richard Ward (8), Stephen Sharp (2).
Above: David Anderson, Martin Dent, Will Cockerell, Jonathan Blackledge, Stephen Sharp, Paul Freary - delighted to hold onto the Ian Logan Memorial Bowl for another year.

Above: Stephen Sharp (stage 6), Phil Wicks (2), Jonathan Blackledge (5), Spencer Barden (4), Alaster Stewart (1) and Tim Watson (3) receive the Ian Logan Trophy – Belgrave’s fourth year of being top of the pile at Rushmoor Arena.  Only Stephen and Jonathan remained in the squad from 2004’s winning line-up.
“Sweatshop” Surrey CC League Race 1 at Brockwell Park, and Phil Wicks (9) and Stephen Sharp (1) slug it out at the front of the field.

Above: Maximum points in the 5000 metres.  At the halfway point Mark Miles was closely shadowed by John Nysaginia (Birchfield) and our own Stephen Sharp but by the end of the race the gap was 11 seconds with Stephen heading the B race by 20 seconds.
